question: Hariprasad Chaurasia plays which of the following musical instruments?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Flute.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hariprasad Chaurasia** plays the** flute,** which is a wind instrument.
 
• The flute is a popular musical instrument in** Indian classical music.**
 
• The sound in the flute is produced by **blowing air across **the edge of the mouthpiece.
 
• Hariprasad Chaurasia is a** renowned flutist **who has been awarded numerous honors for his contribution to Indian classical music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Trumpet** is a **brass instrument** that is commonly used in** jazz and classical music**.

 
 
• This brass instrument with valves features a **two-turn cylindrical tube** with a standard range of** F sharp below middle C upward** for two and a half octaves.
 
 
 
• **Tabla **is a **percussion instrument** that is widely used in Indian classical music.
 
 
• A tabla is a pair of Indian subcontinental **hand drums.**
 
 
 
• **Drum** is a percussion instrument that is used in various **genres of music, including rock, pop, and jazz**.
 
 
• It is a **membranophone** according to the Hornbostel-Sachs categorization method.
